agreedRouting.newUIOperation: dynamic discovery, proven-local numeric address selection, TCP open, close without payload

coreAcceptance: Browse only _remotepairing._tcp in local.; no all-type enumeration, advertising, custom multicast, pairing input or guessed ports.
Resolve SRV and numeric addresses before connection. Never create a connection to an unresolved service endpoint or hostname. Browser loopback metadata does not establish ownership.
Use bounded numeric interface snapshots. Declare accepted interface name/type/flags policy. Excluded VPN interface names do not establish absence of a VPN on the device.
Reject malformed, oversized, wildcard, multicast, limited/directed broadcast, nonlocal and ambiguous addresses. Directed broadcast requires interface netmask/brdaddr knowledge.
IPv6 link-local ownership requires canonical address bytes and validated same-interface scope index. Reject missing/wrong scope rather than guessing. Handle or reject IPv4-mapped IPv6 explicitly.
Revalidate complete relevant interface snapshot immediately before each connection. Ownership, flags, netmask, address set or scope changes stop the probe without connecting.
Connect only to an approved numeric endpoint and discovered port. No LAN candidate fallback or peer substitution.
One overall deadline bounds browse, resolve and connect. At most eight examined results, four approved endpoints, one active connection and a two-second per-connect deadline.

Pre-cancellation, in-stage cancellation, result removal, duplicate results, resolver failure, browser waiting, connection waiting/ready/failure and late callbacks all finish exactly once and tear down resources.
Once TCP is ready, close without application send/receive, QueryType, TLS, account, session, pairing, signing or installation work.
Empty discovery is distinct from proven permission denial. TCP-ready establishes reachability only, not service identity, authenticated transport or renewal.

Report JSON contains only fixed categories, stages, counts, bounded elapsed times and numeric normalized errors; no names, hostnames, address strings, discovered ports, TXT, interface identities, raw payloads or error descriptions.
fixtureAcceptance: Service/type/domain and valid SRV port selection; browser loopback hint with resolved nonlocal address rejects.
IPv4 canonical equality and directed broadcasts with multiple masks; IPv6 compressed forms, explicit scope, missing/wrong scope, multicast/unspecified and mapped-address policy.
Interface changes after approval and immediately before connect produce zero connect calls.
Duplicate/removal/result cap and endpoint cap cannot create unbounded resolution, storage or network work.
Inject clock, browser, resolver, interface snapshot and TCP adapters; synchronously invoking callbacks and timeout/cancel/ready races cannot double resume or leave live handles.
Inject browser/resolver/connection waiting and terminal failures separately; a waiting state can recover to ready within the deadline.
Pre-cancel, every-stage cancel, repeated runs, UI reentry and teardown after disappearance preserve one active run and no postcancel connection.
Synthetic private service names, addresses, TXT and error text are absent from the complete encoded report.
Schema-one fixture still decodes; schema-two absent optional discovery field and actual discovery payload have explicit expected behavior; report metadata accurately describes the operation.

Existing eight QueryType tests remain fixture-only and unchanged in claim. New discovery cases are selected by exact suite/method identity, with zero failures/skips, in the existing isolated Simulator protocol.

UI merely visiting diagnostic does not start discovery. Explicit start exposes discovery result and export, clearly unverified service/renewal state. UI timeout accommodates real bounded deadline, not state-settling sleeps.
integrationConstraints: Update report schema and export envelope together; the old export currently hardcodes dynamicRemotePairingDiscoveryAttempted=false and fixed-loopback interpretation.
Keep original reports and historical validators frozen. Any new offline inspector must branch explicitly by schema rather than accepting arbitrary new fields in schema one.
Add new service and test files plus relevant Info/localization sources to renewal sourceInputs; current source inventory is limited to thirteen inputs.
Expand expected test case identities and shell selections, fixed counts and workflow descriptions together. Added tests must actually run, not merely compile.
NSBonjourServices currently declares only Calibre. Add exact RemotePairing type while preserving existing Calibre behavior.

The current local-network description is configured in two project build settings and overridden by five localized InfoPlist.strings resources. All user-facing versions must cover the new explicit diagnostic purpose.

Smoke source overlays and unsigned finalization currently preserve arbitrary Bonjour/usage fields without asserting the new capability. Verify final built app Info and localization bytes, not only source plist text.
Preserve existing native smoke private overlay/source stamping behavior and source-only Debug path; no entitlement, language-mode, default actor isolation or distribution direction changes.
